title: Bot Auto-Coloring Across All Modes, Completed-Only Stats & New Admin Console
body:
- Extended automatic bot map coloring to Continental modes (Europe, Asia, Africa, Americas), US Statedle, Wojewodztwodle, Powiatdle, and English Countydle with a Hide/Show bot coloring toggle in the map toolbar.
- Expanded local KB auto-coloring to cover most objective factual relations (population, area, currency, language, organizations, rivers, highways, flag colors/symbols, license plates, lakes, national parks, UNESCO sites) while keeping subjective/fuzzy fields excluded.
- Excluded in-progress and abandoned games from daily player counts, results summaries, and admin views so only completed games are counted.
- Rebuilt the Admin Dashboard from scratch with 5 clean sections, category-grouped daily mode views, and a fixed searchable Facts Editor that clearly displays all list and multi-value facts.
